title: Pilot C forward edge test — pre-registered analysis plan
registration_note: This plan is committed BEFORE any forward fixtures are settled and BEFORE any settlement analysis is run. Its SHA-256 is recorded in data/forward/preregistration_ledger.jsonl via the tamper-evident attestation ledger. No post-hoc changes are permitted; a revised plan must be a NEW versioned registration with its own commitment, and the change must be disclosed. Any analysis that deviates from this plan must be reported as EXPLORATORY, not confirmatory.
status_disclaimer: The pilot has demonstrated the CONDITIONS for edge (a near-fair Betfair reference price, measurable book disagreement, a calibrated model) and that the machinery runs end to end. It has NOT demonstrated edge. No edge conclusion may be drawn from unsettled fixtures.

primary_hypothesis.statement: For a given market/line, the Pilot C stat-mixer's forward probability beats the Betfair-exchange de-vigged fair price, net of overround, on genuinely held-out SETTLED forward fixtures that were commit-reveal attested before kickoff.
primary_hypothesis.operationalisation: Bet the side (over/under, or yes/no for BTTS) the model favours vs the Betfair fair price. The primary statistic per market/line is the realized flat-bet ROI on attested +EV selections, with a 95% bootstrap CI (10000 resamples, seed=42). Secondary: model BSS minus Betfair-market BSS on the same settled outcomes.
primary_hypothesis.primary_success_criterion: Realized ROI 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND the per-market edge threshold (below) is met, on a sample of at least the minimum size, at the pre-committed stopping point.

reference_price.rationale: Betfair exchange overround measured ~1.1% in the pilot vs Bet365 ~5.9%; it is the closest to a fair reference.
reference_price.de_vig_method: Proportional (multiplicative) overround removal: fair_p_side = (1/odds_side) / (1/odds_over + 1/odds_under). Identical to scripts implementation (devig / devig_multiplicative).
reference_price.reference_price_binding: The Betfair over/under odds and de-vigged fair prob used for each prediction are bound into that prediction's commitment hash at commit time, so the benchmark cannot be re-chosen after the fact. If Betfair is unavailable for a fixture the fallback book actually used is recorded per prediction (reference_book) and such fixtures are analysed as a SEPARATE, secondary family, not pooled with Betfair-referenced ones.

multiple_testing_family.description: The confirmatory family is the full set of market/line cells tested. Every cell below is counted in the family regardless of outcome; we do NOT drop cells that look bad, nor add cells that look good.
multiple_testing_family.league_stratification: Primary analysis POOLS across covered leagues (the covered-league top-up keeps the fixture universe to leagues with corpus history). A per-league breakdown is SECONDARY/exploratory only; each league x cell that is separately claimed enters the family and is counted. We will not mine league subsets for the largest edge.
multiple_testing_family.multiplicity_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across the 9 primary cells (consistent with the project's existing FDR machinery, src/research/fdr). A cell is a confirmatory winner only if it survives BH-FDR AND meets the edge threshold AND its ROI CI lower bound > 0.
multiple_testing_family.family_wise_note: If secondary families (per-league, non-Betfair books) are reported, each is corrected within itself and labelled exploratory; they do not borrow significance from the primary family.

edge_threshold_per_market.rationale: Against Betfair's ~1.1% overround the required edge to overcome the reference-price vig is ~0.55pp per side (half the overround). We set a conservative REQUIRED de-vigged probability edge threshold that must be exceeded for a selection to count as +EV, and a separate ROI threshold for the confirmatory claim.
edge_threshold_per_market.note: The 1.0pp selection threshold is deliberately at/above the overround-implied ~0.55pp so we do not count marginal noise as +EV. The 2.0pp ROI-claim threshold guards against a statistically-positive-but-economically-trivial result after realistic frictions. Book disagreement measured now (data/results/book_disagreement.json): pooled mean 1.29pp, median 0.91pp, 46% of Bet365-vs-Betfair pairs exceed 1pp — so an edge above threshold is possible but not abundant.

minimum_sample_size.rationale: n=385 gives a +/-5% margin at 95% confidence on a proportion at the worst-case p=0.5. Applied PER market/line cell. A cell with fewer than 385 settled, attested fixtures yields NO confirmatory conclusion for that cell (reported as under-powered).
minimum_sample_size.attestation_requirement: Only fixtures whose prediction was commit-reveal attested BEFORE kickoff (verify_chain passes) are eligible. Unattested / past-kickoff predictions are excluded from the confirmatory sample entirely.

stopping_rule.rule: Confirmatory analysis is run ONCE, when the primary family reaches at least 385 settled+attested fixtures in a MAJORITY (>= 5 of 9) of cells, OR at a hard calendar cutoff of 2027-06-30, whichever comes first. Interim monitoring is limited to operational health (attestation success, settlement counts, calibration drift) and MUST NOT include the primary ROI/BSS edge statistics. We will not stop early because results 'look good'; the settlement count triggers the analysis, not the results.
stopping_rule.peeking_prohibition: No primary edge statistic (ROI, ROI CI, model-minus-market BSS) is to be computed or viewed on the confirmatory sample before the stopping condition is met.
stopping_rule.projected_trigger: Under the covered-league top-up projection (~10 covered upcoming fixtures/week => ~10 settleable/cell/week), 385/cell implies ~38 weeks, i.e. an estimated readout around 2027-05-27 (see data/discovery/pilotC_topup_plan.json). The 2027-06-30 calendar cutoff is the backstop.

analysis_procedure_committed.fit_scheme: Forward predictions use the corpus-trained elastic-net stat-mixer with hyperparameters selected on corpus data (documented as a limitation in data/results/pilotC_bss_provisionality.json). The forward fixtures themselves are never used in training or hyperparameter selection.
analysis_procedure_committed.point_in_time: Features for each forward fixture use only data before that fixture's kickoff (verified point-in-time in the feature builders).
analysis_procedure_committed.bet_side: Bet whichever side the de-vigged Betfair edge points to (fixed in scripts/ev_test_metrics_vs_bet365.py simulate_flat_bet_return).
analysis_procedure_committed.what_would_falsify: If, at the stopping point, no primary cell has an ROI CI lower bound > 0 after BH-FDR, the pilot has FAILED to demonstrate edge and will be reported as such. A near-fair reference price plus measurable disagreement is necessary but not sufficient for edge.

provisional_result_handling.pilot_9_for_9_bss: The pilot's 9-for-9 positive BSS is a corpus single-split OOS-in-time result (large held-out n), NOT a forward-OOS result. It is treated as in-sample-of-a-sample with respect to this forward experiment and is NOT evidence for the primary hypothesis. See data/results/pilotC_bss_provisionality.json.
